title: Zurich-Themed RMarkdown Template
text: can use parameters R Markdown reports using zueridown template. However, two relevant conditions take place. First, possible include YAML r calls like r params$country. Therefore, document title subtitle using parameter, use title /subtitle parameters function cd_page_title_box cd_page_title_box accordingly, instance: Second, use zueridown output format render parameterized report. Consequently, creating zueridown template (instance: "report.Rmd") use option output_format following example:
code: cd_page_title_box(   title = paste0("Stadt Zürich: Auswertung", params$country, "verkehrszählstelle", params$Name),   title_size = "40pt",   color_palette = cd_color_palette("palette1"),   ) rmarkdown::render(   input = "report.Rmd",   output_format = zueridown::zueridown(),   output_file = "Country_1_report.pdf",   params = list(country = "Switzerland", Name = "name_1"))

what: How to implement full width tables?
title: Zurich-Themed RMarkdown Template
text: option full_width = T kableExtra uses tabu LaTeX package, package problems colors functionalities. solve zueridown function full_width_tabular . function changes LaTeX package tabu tabularx. use properly follow next steps: specify chunk options: ```{r, .width = "\\textwidth", results='asis', warning=FALSE}. Set code table full_width = T Add function full_width_tabular end code table. Example
code: ```{r tab1, out.width = "\\textwidth", results='asis', warning=FALSE} kableExtra::kable(head(iris),                   col.names = gsub("[.]", " ", names(iris)),                   table.env='table',                   caption = "\\textbf{Titel der Tabelle} \\newline Untertitel der Tabelle",                   booktabs = T) %>%             kable_styling(font_size = 9, full_width = T, latex_options = "HOLD_position") %>%             row_spec(0,bold=TRUE) %>%             row_spec(2,background="red")  %>%             full_width_tabular() ```
